formats.key: addLiquidity(address tokenA,address tokenB,uint256 amountADesired,uint256 amountBDesired,uint256 amountAMin,uint256 amountBMin,address to,uint256 deadline)
effects: Takes amountA of tokenA from the signer and sends it to the pair. amountA is between amountAMin and amountADesired.
Takes amountB of tokenB from the signer and sends it to the pair. amountB is between amountBMin and amountBDesired.
Mints UNI-V2 LP tokens to `to`. The pool reserves decide the amount.
Creates the pair if it does not exist yet. The signer then sets the initial price with the full desired amounts.
Reverts after the deadline.
formats.shown: Add up to X tokenA and up to Y tokenB as liquidity, with the minimums, the LP recipient and the deadline.

findings.title: addLiquidity: the amount of LP tokens minted to the recipient is not shown and has no bound.
findings.evidence: UniswapV2Router02.sol addLiquidity: `liquidity = IUniswapV2Pair(pair).mint(to);`. In case 0 the signer received 2961077006359078 UNI-V2 and no field states an amount for it.
findings.fix: None possible: the pool reserves decide the amount, and the calldata has no minimum for it.

cases.notes: Both deposits were the full desired amounts and match the screen. The screen says LP tokens arrive but gives no amount.

formats.key: addLiquidityETH(address token,uint256 amountTokenDesired,uint256 amountTokenMin,uint256 amountETHMin,address to,uint256 deadline)
effects: Takes amountToken of the token from the signer, between amountTokenMin and amountTokenDesired.
Takes msg.value in ETH. Wraps amountETH (between amountETHMin and msg.value) to WETH and sends it to the pair.
Refunds any unused ETH (msg.value minus amountETH) to msg.sender.
Mints UNI-V2 LP tokens to `to`. The pool reserves decide the amount.
formats.shown: Add up to X token and up to the sent ETH as liquidity, with the minimums, the recipient and the deadline.

findings.title: addLiquidityETH: the amount of LP tokens minted is not shown, and neither is the ETH refund.
findings.evidence: addLiquidityETH: `liquidity = IUniswapV2Pair(pair).mint(to);` and `if (msg.value > amountETH) TransferHelper.safeTransferETH(msg.sender, msg.value - amountETH);`. In case 1 the signer received 62048368229954282979666 UNI-V2 with no amount shown.
findings.fix: None needed for the refund, because 'up to' covers it. The LP amount is decided by the pool.

cases.notes: 0.5 ETH and 7.7e9 ERIREF left the wallet as shown. LP tokens arrived with no amount on screen.

formats.key: removeLiquidity(address tokenA,address tokenB,uint256 liquidity,uint256 amountAMin,uint256 amountBMin,address to,uint256 deadline)
effects: Moves `liquidity` LP tokens of the tokenA/tokenB pair from the signer to the pair and burns them. This spends the signer's allowance to the router.
The pair sends amountA of tokenA (at least amountAMin) to `to`.
The pair sends amountB of tokenB (at least amountBMin) to `to`.
formats.shown: Remove N UNI-V2 for at least A tokenA and B tokenB, with the recipient and the deadline.

findings.title: removeLiquidity: the minimums are checked on what the pair sends, not on what reaches the recipient.
findings.evidence: removeLiquidity: `(uint amount0, uint amount1) = IUniswapV2Pair(pair).burn(to); ... require(amountB >= amountBMin)`. For a fee-on-transfer token, `to` gets less than 'Minimum to Receive'. Case 2 shows a WETH arrival but no EMERALD Transfer to the signer.
findings.fix: None from the descriptor. The token's own fee logic decides it.

cases.notes: The receipt has no EMERALD movement, probably because the token emits odd events. The WETH received, 0.01018, is above the 0.00993 minimum.

formats.key: removeLiquidityETH(address token,uint256 liquidity,uint256 amountTokenMin,uint256 amountETHMin,address to,uint256 deadline)
effects: Moves `liquidity` LP tokens of the token/WETH pair from the signer and burns them.
Sends amountToken of the token (at least amountTokenMin) to `to` through the router.
Unwraps amountETH of WETH (at least amountETHMin) and sends it to `to` as native ETH.
formats.shown: Remove N UNI-V2 for at least X token and Y ETH, with the recipient and the deadline.

cases.notes: Both minimums are 0, shown literally. The reader correctly saw that there is no protection.

formats.key: removeLiquidityETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens(address token,uint256 liquidity,uint256 amountTokenMin,uint256 amountETHMin,address to,uint256 deadline)
effects: Burns `liquidity` LP tokens of the token/WETH pair, taken from the signer.
Sends the router's whole token balance to `to`. The minimum is checked before transfer fees.
Unwraps amountETH of WETH (at least amountETHMin) and sends it to `to` as ETH.
formats.shown: Remove N UNI-V2 for at least Y ETH and X token before token fees, with the recipient and the deadline.

cases.notes: The 'before token fees' label matches the code.

formats.key: removeLiquidityETHWithPermit(address token,uint256 liquidity,uint256 amountTokenMin,uint256 amountETHMin,address to,uint256 deadline,bool approveMax,uint8 v,bytes32 r,bytes32 s)
effects: Uses the signer's permit to set the router's allowance on the LP token: unlimited if approveMax, otherwise exactly `liquidity`. An unlimited allowance stays after the call.
Burns `liquidity` LP tokens taken from the signer.
Sends at least amountTokenMin of the token to `to`.
Sends at least amountETHMin of ETH to `to`.
formats.shown: Remove N UNI-V2 for at least X token and Y ETH, with the LP approval scope (unlimited to router, or this removal only), the recipient and the deadline.

cases.notes: The unlimited LP approval to the router is shown as 'Unlimited to router' and the reader understood it.

formats.key: removeLiquidityETHWithPermitSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens(address token,uint256 liquidity,uint256 amountTokenMin,uint256 amountETHMin,address to,uint256 deadline,bool approveMax,uint8 v,bytes32 r,bytes32 s)
effects: Uses the signer's permit to set the router's LP allowance: unlimited or exactly `liquidity`.
Burns `liquidity` LP tokens taken from the signer.
Sends the router's whole token balance to `to`. The minimum is checked before fees.
Sends at least amountETHMin of ETH to `to`.
formats.shown: Remove N UNI-V2 for at least Y ETH and X token before token fees, with the approval scope, the recipient and the deadline.

cases.notes: The approval was 'This removal only', and the receipt shows an approval of exactly `liquidity`.

formats.key: removeLiquidityWithPermit(address tokenA,address tokenB,uint256 liquidity,uint256 amountAMin,uint256 amountBMin,address to,uint256 deadline,bool approveMax,uint8 v,bytes32 r,bytes32 s)
effects: Uses the signer's permit to set the router's LP allowance: unlimited or exactly `liquidity`.
Burns `liquidity` LP tokens taken from the signer.
The pair sends at least amountAMin of tokenA to `to`.
The pair sends at least amountBMin of tokenB to `to`.
formats.shown: Remove N UNI-V2 for at least A tokenA and B tokenB, with the approval scope, the recipient and the deadline.

formats.key: swapExactTokensForETH(uint256 amountIn,uint256 amountOutMin,address[] path,address to,uint256 deadline)
effects: Takes amountIn of path[0] from the signer. This spends the signer's allowance to the router.
Unwraps at least amountOutMin of WETH and sends it to `to` as native ETH.
formats.shown: Swap X token for at least Y ETH, with the recipient and the deadline.

effects: Takes amountIn of path[0] from the signer and spends the signer's allowance to the router.
Unwraps the router's WETH output (at least amountOutMin) and sends it to `to` as ETH.
formats.shown: Swap X token for at least Y ETH, with the recipient and the deadline.

findings.title: swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens: spending the signer's existing token allowance is not stated.
findings.evidence: In case 13 the mined Approval for Gato from the signer to the router (signer 'grant') shows the allowance going down on transferFrom. The screen has no approval line.
findings.fix: None needed. Spending the allowance of the named router is the prerequisite of the swap.

cases.notes: The ETH went to a third-party recipient, and the screen shows that recipient. The allowance spend is not on screen.
